content: A ɗakhga Yasu ad furakh sar
Ka ɗakhga Yasu ad furakh sar kǝlatǝm mits, a batǝran ad ndzǝɗa lakdu itsǝra kǝ siɗikw bǝzan, zǝ mbakha itsera kǝ khulf kuz zǝ liye kwal yan.
Auna ɗakhakh dzǝran na kǝ furakh na kǝlatǝm mits. Dǝg chaka, Siman ai ɗakhdud Bitrus zǝ zǝrbab sar Ndros, Yakub zǝr Zabadi zǝ zǝrbab sar Yukhan,
Filibus, Bartamawus, Tom, Matiyu dadak chaw khadam, Yakub zǝr Alf, Tladdiyus,
Siman ud ya Kanan
, Yakhud Iskariyoti dadake bǝdu Yasu kǝ kǝɗgakǝɗ.
A ɓǝlatǝrǝf Yasu ad kǝlatǝm mitsen
A ɓǝlatǝrǝf Yasu kǝ dzǝrana kǝ zar ɓǝlakh kǝlatǝm mits, ka tǝkhatǝrna ad lava kwarne, “Damba da vak liye kwal Yakhudakh bi, tsuguna damba da tlǝrna kǝs ya Samariyakh bi,
dam da vak udakh ya Izrail liye zaɗgan ndǝk tuwaghakh.
Madǝv kur ǝn dǝgal, kwaramatǝra lav Yazhigǝl kwarne, ‘Tlǝksa Ghǝrazhigǝla a khǝrzǝgan.’
Mbakhama liye kwal yang, tsiyanǝf kur liye amtsǝgan, mbakhanu kur liye ǝn tukw fich, lakwakh du kur sǝɗikw bǝzanakh ǝn vǝgh kǝ udakh. A bakura butiyud, bǝdu ghǝrura buti.
Ɓam ba kwaɓ dawan zǝ shabu zǝ jingal ǝn mbǝlur bi.
Ɓam ba jilaɗur bi, tsa zǝ gabag mits bi, tsa kimbak, ɓam ba tsa juguljugulur bi, wirva dadak tlǝra kalkal gǝmadu dǝg siga tlǝr sar tsin.
“Itsera kǝ kǝs zǝ gǝdzar kǝsakhe a da kur damb, gatam ga ud charan ai da giɗa kur dagh tangw da da tǝ sarte da tsida kur.
Da ka da kur da mǝghen, ka nǝghatǝrdi kur kwarne, ‘gabǝr ǝn tǝghǝr tsǝkur.’
Da ka chau kurkhai liye mǝghen, tsukwa gabǝruren ǝn tǝghǝr tsitar, ai da chau kurkhai ba itar bi, ka wura kurva gabǝrur.
Ɗaga mǝgha zǝ kǝse kwal chau kurkhai, awa bi kalwal kǝ tsǝn lavur, pangdu kur lagwate ǝn tǝ sigur dǝn sǝgawala kur ǝn kǝsen.
Kaɗi ǝn tǝkha kura kǝ, da ziwardal kǝ Sodom zǝ Gomora ud tǝghǝr kǝ kǝsen fitsa takalav.”
Mbakhǝle da saks
Ya digiyam, ya ni ɓǝla kura ɓǝla ka ngwaɗa tuwaghakh ǝn tatak ya ghǝda tǝghalakh, wirva yan ɗemekh ni kur ndǝk dǝg vukhakh, tsugun kalali nikur ndǝk kakur.
Tsukamana ghǝr kǝ udakh, wirva da lang kur langa itar da vak takalav, tsuguna da dlagha kuru kiɓ itar ǝn gud dzakhavakh tar.
Wirvǝn gataks tsǝka kur, da lang kur lang itar da tǝvuk kǝ li man tlǝks ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tsǝkur zǝ shikakh, wirva ki da kwardu lav zǝɗan tsǝkur ǝn tǝvuk tar zǝn tǝvuk liye kwal Yakhudakh.
Da ka da zǝɓ kurdǝghǝr itar da tǝvuk li taka lav, dzamam ba dǝ dǝge da kwara kur bi biya da kwara ndar kur bi. Ən tǝ yanen kǝ sart da bakura bǝg ka dǝ lave da kwara kur.
Wirva kuram ba da kwar laven bi, wirva Sǝɗikw Chuwaɗaɗan Dadure ǝn kur, in da kwarado lava sǝgawal ǝn ghayur.
Zǝrbab da bǝdu zǝrbab sar kǝ kǝɗa kǝɗa tsud, dad tsuguna da bǝdu ad zǝr sar, zara tsuguna da tsiyara kǝ baba zǝ dad itar, zǝ man dǝgakhai da nala kǝ dlǝva ɗul ǝmtsa tar.
Itsawara da nagh kur ba wirva ka bi. Ude bǝga rǝv tangw da tǝ mbasa sar da katakatud.
Da ka bakura dlaɗud ǝn mbiyan kǝ kǝs, ka kwaya kur da tlǝrna kǝs, ya kaɗiyǝn ǝn kwara kura kǝ, kǝda ditla ɗaga kǝs ya Izrail tsǝkur, da sosǝg ka Zǝr Ud.
Na dadake ǝn tsag digit da mal dadak ai ǝn tsagardu tsaga bi, awana zǝr tlǝre malga dad mǝgh sar bi.
Da ka tlakǝnalin kǝ dadak tsag lava kǝ nǝga ndǝk dadak tsagdu lav, zǝr tlǝr tsuguna ndǝk dad mǝghsar. Da ka mal ya wurdu kha nǝv itar kǝ dad mǝghena, da ɗakha dǝ uɗitar ad yakhsari?
Ude da gǝdzud
Wirva yan, gǝdzamtǝr bi, wirva na dǝge khǝmban ai kwal da mǝdlandowal tsud bi, tsuguna na dǝge ɓǝghan kwal da tsatsud bi.
Dǝge ǝn kwara kura kǝ ǝn gurtl, kwaram kwar ǝn tǝ fatsi tǝghǝr. Dǝge kwarakh dagh ud da tlim, tlǝkhamdu tlǝkhǝn tǝ mbachar.
Gǝdzam ba dǝ liye tǝkha kǝ kǝɗga vǝghur bi, ya tǝkh ba itar kǝ kǝɗga saf bi. Gǝdzam gǝdza Yazhigǝl ai tǝkh kǝ kǝɗga vǝgha zǝ saf tangw da tǝ fay.
Mits bakh chughwaghwakh ǝn sukwduwud ǝn tǝ shabu kitakula? Na bai da ɓǝlal itsa kitakul da khay ai kwal da tsa kǝ dadur bi.
Afke itsa guj ghǝrura kǝdlana.
Wirva yana, gǝdzam bi. Afke a malga kur ad chughwaghwakh zikǝn kǝ ndanga char.
Khayanǝf khaya zǝ kuɗ khayanǝf khaya dǝ Yasu
Ɗaga ude mǝdla kwarne dǝg sar kǝ ǝn tǝvuk kǝ udakh, ghǝrar tsuguna da mǝdla mǝdla ka kwarne dǝgar ghǝrsar ǝn tǝvuk Dadare ǝn ghǝrazhigǝl.
Ɗaga ude bǝga tsuguwar ǝn tǝvuk kǝ udakh, ghǝrar tsuguna da bǝg tsugu kǝn tǝvuk kǝ Dadare ǝn ghǝrazhigǝl.
Gabǝr ba ɓadagh ka bi pǝg
Dzamam ba kwarne gabǝr a ɓadagh ka da lard bi. A so kǝ wirva ɓado gabǝr ba ka bi, ya katsakar.
Ya so kǝ,

content.text: Ghawul tsuguna zǝ dzik sar nus.
Dadak mǝgha yakh sar da nǝga kǝ tlǝghum sar.

content: Ude ǝn way bab sar zǝ dad sar mal tsǝk, a tlal ba kǝ nǝga kǝ zǝr ɓǝlara bi. Ude ǝn way zǝr sar awana dugh sar mal tsǝka tsugun, a tlal ba kǝ nǝga kǝ zǝr ɓǝlara bi.
Ude ɓǝf ba dǝ ufa khǝrta sar kǝ gataks gata bi, a tlal ba kǝ nǝga kǝ zǝr ɓǝlara bi.
Ude ǝn nagh kat safa sar, da bǝgh. Ude kǝɗdu safa sar wirva kǝ, da gǝmadu gǝm.
Dǝg siga tlǝr
Ɗaga ude a chau kurkhai, ka chau ka yin, ude chau kai tsuguna Dade ɓǝlakondagh a chau gin.

Ɗaga ude chauga tlayang Yazhigǝl da chauga kǝ wirve tlayangin. Dǝg sige da baruda, da kalkal zǝ dǝg tlayangen. Ɗaga ude chauga dadak kalali da chauga kǝ wirve dadak kalali yin, dǝg sige da baruda da kalkal zǝ dǝg dadak kalaliyen.
Ɗaga ude ǝnkaru itsa kwat yu kitakul ak khǝɗikan ǝn tatak furar wirve furarin, ya jir ǝn kwara kura kǝ, na ba da bǝghǝn dǝg sig sar bi.
